Aldmoor bog field log, winter 2024-25, kept by M. Lopez.
Core AB-17, 3 December: depth 4.2 m, pH 4.1, water table 12 cm below surface.
Core AB-18, 3 December: depth 3.8 m, pH 4.6.
Core AB-19, 10 December: depth 5.1 m, pH 3.9; the corer jammed at 5 m and was freed by J. Pike.
Core AB-20, 10 December: not taken, the site was flooded.
Samuel Osei joined the trip on 10 December to learn the coring method.
